# 037-car

**Provider.** Hertz, direct car rental reservation confirmation in US English.

**Format.** Email with HTML and text parts. The confirmation number is in a black bar; pick-up and return are two bordered columns with a shared row of location hours and instructions below, then the vehicle table, an itemised rate block, the cancellation policy and loyalty upsells.

**Why.** A one-week rental with 12-hour times (`2:15 PM`, `11:00 AM`) to convert, an estimated total built from a weekly base rate plus six airport and state charges, and a loyalty member number printed near the confirmation number that must not be taken as the booking reference. The vehicle line is separate from the car class (`Full-Size (F)`), and the pick-up and return instructions are run-in labels inside one table cell.
